newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - APRIL 22.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - APRIL 22.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by the Radio Latvia at noon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot ouch for their accuracy.
- Latvia's ambassador to the U.S., Ojar Kalninsh, today joins representatives from the three Baltic countries and Poland in an address to the Congressional commission on OECD issues.
- Latvia, Estonia and Russia in Moscow today finalised technical details on a border post on the Pededze river.
- Daugavpils, the second largest Latvian town, looks for more sales of its food produce in Moscow.
